description: Reference backtest: BTCUSDT 1h 2024-04-01 to 2024-05-30, default strategy_config.json
note: Established after Step 3 parity gate (config-driven engine iso-functional with legacy). Survives: allocation fix, config_path fix. Fails if: PnL computation changes, matching logic changes, engine wiring changes.
e010_s3_rebaseline_2026-09-10: DECLARED DEFAULT-BEHAVIOR CHANGE (CLAUDE.fork.md rule #4), not a regression. E-010 S3 shipped real, nonzero, per-symbol slippage as the default cost model (config/cost_model.json: binance/margin BTCUSDT=1bps, previously 0bps flat) and folded the effective cost model into run provenance (config_sha256), closing a CUL-55-class gap (see core/backtester.py::_end_of_backtest's cost_model fold). Both changes shift this fixture: config_sha256 8-char prefix moves 5ccbec42 -> 9f3b09c1 (cost_model is now part of what's hashed), and net_pnl/sharpe move -231.758912/-5.646 -> -238.279247/-5.812 (BTCUSDT's 1bps fill-price adjustment on every trade). trade_count is UNCHANGED at 24 -- slippage moves fill price, not signal timing. data_sha256 (5a75366c...) is UNCHANGED -- no data changed. Measured by re-running this exact fixture's backtest against the post-S3 code on 2026-09-10; full config_sha256 = 9f3b09c19c140746f24de89da8258d16a9350f45ccaddecbde2be08025bcf903.

coverage_gap.finding: This fixture CANNOT detect the F7 defect class. Verified by execution: reverting trading-bot/strategies/main_strategy.py to 16a53f47^ (pre-fix) and re-running `pytest -m slow tests/test_regression_backtest.py --timeout=600` reproduces trade_count=24 / net_pnl=-231.758912 / sharpe=-5.646, identical to the fixed code. A green run here is therefore SILENT on whether F7 is fixed -- it is not evidence that it is.
coverage_gap.why: Inferred from strategy_config.json, NOT separately executed: only the mean_reversion regime carries components (trending/chop/unknown are null), and required_bars already satisfies that regime's warmup=51 by the time is_ready() is first consulted -- so the stale-vs-current regime read yields the same readiness answer either way. Exercising F7 needs a window/config where the current bar classifies into a regime whose components are not yet warm.
coverage_gap.implication: 16a53f47's commit message predicted this baseline would move. It did not, and the non-movement says nothing about the fix. Do not cite a green run on this fixture as F7 validation; F7's coverage lives in tests/test_ungated_config_pattern.py.
coverage_gap.runner_note: pytest.ini sets a global --timeout=30, which kills this test inside its module-scoped backtest fixture. Pass --timeout=600.

rebaselined.why: mean_reversion is the only regime carrying components, so routing unmatched bars into it ran the RSI strategy over 794 of 1440 bars instead of 208. The 586 unclassifiable bars now sit flat (per_regime.unknown.avg_forecast == 0.0).
rebaselined.previous_values_superseded: Validly measured 2026-06-27 (0ca4666d) against a then-legal config. V9 was introduced 2026-06-30 (d570ffcd) covering only 'trending'; 2e244ebd (2026-07-06, nine days after the fixture) broadened it to mean_reversion/chop with rules non-empty, which is what blocks this config today - AdvancedStrategy runs the same validation at construction (main_strategy.py:28, raise at :32), so the old default_regime errors before the first bar. The engine itself is unchanged: a control run with only the V9 check suppressed still yields 76 trades / -270.797404 / -4.364; the recorded net -270.797424 reproduces to 2.0e-5, not exactly (cause unidentified, presumed float accumulation order). Stale in the ordinary sense - superseded by a later validation rule, not unreachable by the engine.
rebaselined.engine_unchanged: No PnL, matching or wiring code was touched. Confirmed by reproduction: the post-fix figures were produced independently on Linux/Python 3.10/pandas 2.x (sandbox) and macOS/Python 3.13/pandas 2.3.3, landing on identical config_sha 5ccbec42 and data_sha 5a75366c. A Mac-local or library-version artifact could not agree across both.
rebaselined.voids: Every baseline measured with default_regime 'mean_reversion' on this config, including the previous values above. Do not compare across the boundary.
